entries.label: kCoastElev
entries.description: Elevation threshold separating sea from land (coastline level).

entries.label: kBorderWidth
entries.description: Width in cells of the forced-sea border around the map edge.

entries.label: kEdgeFade
entries.description: Strength of the fade towards sea at the map edge.

entries.label: kShelfScale
entries.description: Spatial scale of the continental shelf noise.

entries.label: kMinLandmass
entries.description: Minimum size of a landmass; smaller ones are removed.

entries.label: kMinIslandShare
entries.description: Minimum share of total land an island may hold.

entries.label: kMaxIslandShare
entries.description: Maximum share of total land an island may hold.

entries.label: kIslandGapMin
entries.description: Minimum sea gap in cells between islands.

entries.label: kIslandGapMax
entries.description: Maximum sea gap in cells between islands.

entries.label: kIslandSpacing
entries.description: Target spacing between island centres.

entries.label: kWarpAmp
entries.description: Amplitude of the domain warp applied to the landmass shape (default is a guess).

entries.label: kCoastAmp
entries.description: Amplitude of coastline noise (default is a guess).

entries.label: kRidgeCellMin
entries.description: Minimum ridge strength for a cell to count as part of a ridge.

entries.label: kRidgeWidthMin
entries.description: Minimum ridge width in cells.

entries.label: kRidgeWidthMax
entries.description: Maximum ridge width in cells.

entries.label: kSpineReach
entries.description: How far the main ridge spine reaches across the landmass.

entries.label: kRingReach
entries.description: How far the ring ridges reach from the landmass centre.

entries.label: kMinPiece
entries.description: Minimum size of a ridge piece; smaller pieces are dropped.

entries.label: kPassFloor
entries.description: Minimum elevation floor kept in mountain passes.

entries.label: kBarrierQuantile
entries.description: Elevation quantile above which barrier ridges are placed.

entries.label: kBarrierWobble
entries.description: Lateral wobble of barrier ridges in cells.

entries.label: kBarrierHalfWidth
entries.description: Half width of barrier ridges in cells.

entries.label: kPlateauInner
entries.description: Inner fraction of a plateau that is held flat.

entries.label: kVentSpacing
entries.description: Spacing between volcanic vents in cells.

entries.label: kLowlandRise
entries.description: Gentle elevation rise applied to lowlands.

entries.label: kInlandScale
entries.description: Spatial scale of the inland elevation noise.

entries.label: kMountainHeight
entries.description: Elevation contributed by mountain ridges.

entries.label: kBarrierHeight
entries.description: Elevation contributed by barrier ridges.

entries.label: kVentHeight
entries.description: Elevation contributed by volcanic vents.

entries.label: kVentRadius
entries.description: Radius of a volcanic vent in cells.

entries.label: kRuggedAmp
entries.description: Amplitude of the ruggedness noise added to terrain.

entries.label: kMinBasinDepth
entries.description: Minimum depth for a depression to count as a basin.

entries.label: kHighlandRain
entries.description: Extra rainfall weight applied on highlands for river flow.

entries.label: kFlowMax
entries.description: Maximum flow accumulation value.

entries.label: kFlowMin
entries.description: Minimum flow accumulation for a cell to be part of a river.

entries.label: kSourceMinElev
entries.description: Minimum elevation for a river source.

entries.label: kMinRiverLength
entries.description: Minimum river length in cells.

entries.label: kRidgeCost
entries.description: Path cost added when a river crosses a ridge.

entries.label: kBarrierCost
entries.description: Path cost added when a river crosses a barrier.

entries.label: kRiverCorridor
entries.description: Width fraction of the river corridor.

entries.label: kCarveMax
entries.description: Maximum elevation a river carves from terrain.

entries.label: kCarveFullAcc
entries.description: Flow accumulation at which river carving reaches its maximum.

entries.label: kShelfWidth
entries.description: Width in cells of the coastal shelf.

entries.label: kCliffSlope
entries.description: Slope threshold above which terrain is a cliff.

entries.label: kSteepSlope
entries.description: Slope threshold above which terrain is steep.

entries.label: kPeakElev
entries.description: Elevation threshold for peaks.

entries.label: kMountainElev
entries.description: Elevation threshold for mountains.

entries.label: kHighlandElev
entries.description: Elevation threshold for highlands.

entries.label: kHillElev
entries.description: Elevation threshold for hills.

entries.label: kHillSlope
entries.description: Slope threshold for hills.

entries.label: kLatCool
entries.description: Temperature drop from the equator towards the poles.

entries.label: kLapse
entries.description: Temperature drop with elevation (lapse rate).

entries.label: kRiverPenalty
entries.description: Penalty applied to river-adjacent cells in the temperature or moisture model.

entries.label: kMoistScale
entries.description: Spatial scale of the moisture noise.

entries.label: kBandBlend
entries.description: Width of the blend between climate bands.

entries.label: kAirDecay
entries.description: Per-cell decay of airborne moisture.

entries.label: kOrographic
entries.description: Strength of the orographic rainfall effect.

entries.label: kProximityMix
entries.description: Mix weight of water proximity into moisture.

entries.label: kRainBonus
entries.description: Moisture bonus from rainfall.

entries.label: kWetlandMaxElev
entries.description: Maximum elevation for wetlands.

entries.label: kWetlandMoist
entries.description: Minimum moisture for wetlands.

entries.label: kPlateauWet
entries.description: Moisture adjustment applied on plateaus.

entries.label: kMaxFixupPasses
entries.description: Maximum number of biome fix-up passes.

entries.label: kMinRegionCells
entries.description: Minimum number of cells in a region.

entries.label: kSeedBiomeBonus
entries.description: Seeding bonus for same-biome cells when growing regions.

entries.label: kBiomeMismatch
entries.description: Cost for growing a region across a biome mismatch.

entries.label: kRegionRidgeCost
entries.description: Cost for growing a region across a ridge.

entries.label: kMaxRegionShare
entries.description: Maximum region size as a multiple of the average region size.

entries.label: kMaxRegionSlack
entries.description: Extra cells of slack allowed over the maximum region size.

entries.label: kMaxAbsorbedShare
entries.description: Maximum share of cells a region may absorb from a neighbour.

entries.label: kMaxFragmentShare
entries.description: Maximum share of a region that may be fragmented.

entries.label: kNodeSpacing
entries.description: Spacing between geography nodes in cells.

entries.label: kCorridorSpacing
entries.description: Spacing between corridor nodes in cells.

entries.label: kCoastalGapReach
entries.description: Reach in cells for coastal gap nodes.

entries.label: kRiverNodeSpacing
entries.description: Spacing between river nodes in cells.

entries.label: kCellsPerNode
entries.description: Number of cells represented by one node.

entries.label: Terrain type
entries.description: The S-1 TerrainType ids, in code enum order (a C++ parity test pins this list to the enum).

entries.label: Terrain passable
entries.description: Whether the placeholder navigation profile lets a unit enter this terrain.

entries.label: Terrain cost
entries.description: Placeholder navigation path cost of entering this terrain.

entries.label: Soil depth multiplier
entries.description: Provisional: soil depth multiplier per terrain type (A5 consumes it; S-2.6 tunes it).

entries.label: Orographic factor
entries.description: Provisional: per-terrain orographic rainfall factor (A4 and S-1 Stage 13 may consume it).

entries.label: Terrain runoff
entries.description: Provisional: fraction of rainfall that runs off this terrain (A5 consumes it).
